zh.title: 新纖攜手瑞士JEDSY引進醫藥物流無人機
zh.summary: 新纖聯手極現科技與瑞士JEDSY，引進醫藥物流無人機在台落地。
body: 台灣新光合成纖維（新纖）於2026年9月8日宣布，聯手轉投資的極現科技與瑞士無人機商JEDSY簽署合作意向書，計畫共同成立合資公司「極新科技」，引進醫藥物流無人機方案並在台灣全面落地產製。
JEDSY董事長維拉瑟表示，公司未來計畫將生產線從瑞士移至台灣，並進駐新光幼獅園區InnovHUB。極現科技董事長徐偉城則指出，極現已取得衛福部核發的無人機醫療物流許可，具備救災等多次實際任務經驗。
新纖於2022年取得桃園「幼獅青年創業村暨智慧製造園區」50年地上權，第一期預計2027年5月完工，以打造智慧無人載具中心。新纖計畫利用其工程塑膠與3D列印技術，積極布局低空經濟。

en.title: Shinkong Fibers Partners with JEDSY for Taiwan Medical Drone Logistics
en.summary: Shinkong Fibers partners with Swiss firm JEDSY to introduce medical logistics drones in Taiwan.
body: On September 8, 2026, Shinkong Synthetic Fibers, its affiliate Ji-Xian Technology, and Swiss drone manufacturer JEDSY signed a letter of intent to establish a joint venture, Ji-Xin Technology, to localize medical logistics drone solutions in Taiwan.

JEDSY Chairman Herbert Weirather stated that drone production will relocate from Switzerland to Taiwan, making JEDSY the first international firm to enter Shinkong's InnovHUB. Ji-Xian Technology will help deploy these services using its medical logistics permit from the Ministry of Health and Welfare.

Shinkong secured a 50-year land-use right for Taoyuan's Youth Lion Smart Manufacturing Park in 2022, with the first phase completing in May 2027. The company plans to leverage its engineering plastics and 3D printing to target the low-altitude economy.

zh.title: 紐西蘭空軍NH90直升機飛行時數突破3,000小時
zh.summary: 紐西蘭空軍NH90直升機突破3,000飛行小時，成為全球首架達成該紀錄機型。
body: 紐西蘭皇家空軍（RNZAF）旗下的一架NH90直升機於2026年8月26日達成3,000小時飛行時數里程碑。根據空中巴士發布的資訊，這架直升機是全球首架累計飛行時數突破3,000小時關卡的NH90機型。
在過往的機隊計畫發展中，空中巴士直升機公司曾於2026年7月30日在馬里尼亞納向法國裝備總署（DGA）交付首架特種作戰用NH90 Standard 2直升機，該機並於同日轉交法國陸軍輕航空兵（ALAT）服役。
法國共訂購18架NH90 Standard 2直升機，預計於2029年中期前交付完畢。此外，西班牙亦於2025年12月訂購了31架相近標準之NH90直升機。

en.title: RNZAF NH90 Becomes First Globally to Pass 3,000 Flight Hours
en.summary: A Royal New Zealand Air Force NH90 helicopter has reached 3,000 flight hours, setting a global milestone.
body: A Royal New Zealand Air Force (RNZAF) NH90 helicopter reached 3,000 flight hours on August 26, 2026. According to Airbus, this is the first NH90 helicopter anywhere in the world to pass the 3,000 flight hour milestone.

In historical program developments, Airbus Helicopters handed over the first NH90 Standard 2 helicopter to the French Armament General Directorate (DGA) at Marignane on July 30, 2026. The DGA transferred the helicopter to French Army Light Aviation (ALAT) on the same day.

France has ordered a total of 18 NH90 Standard 2 helicopters scheduled for delivery by mid-2029 for special forces operations. Additionally, Spain joined the program in December 2025 by ordering 31 NH90 helicopters in a similar configuration.

zh.title: 索契機場（AER）遭無人機襲擊 衛星照示兩架俄直升機疑似損毀
zh.summary: 烏克蘭襲擊索契機場；衛星顯示兩架直升機疑似被毀；航班一度受阻
body: 根據 AeroTime 報導，在烏克蘭於 2026 年 9 月 4 日對俄羅斯索契機場發動無人機襲擊後，流傳的衛星圖像顯示，該機場軍用停機區內有兩架俄羅斯攻擊直升機疑似被毀，另有一架直升機受損。開源網路頻道將其識別為一架卡莫夫 Ka-52 與一架米爾 Mi-28 直升機，另有一架 Mi-8 系列直升機受損。
此次襲擊也波及索契機場附近的燃料儲存設施。俄羅斯當局承認襲擊後發生了燃料庫火災。這起事件導致索契機場的民航營運受阻超過 11 個小時，期間許多航班面臨延誤、取消或轉降，且機場的航空器加油作業也受到了限制。

en.title: Satellite Images Show Russian Helicopters Apparently Destroyed at Sochi Airport (AER) After Drone Attack
en.summary: Drone attack on Sochi Airport; Russian helicopters apparently destroyed; flight operations disrupted
body: Satellite imagery released following Ukraine's drone attack on Russia's Sochi Airport (AER) on September 4, 2026, appears to show two Russian attack helicopters destroyed and a third helicopter damaged at the facility's military flight line. Open-source assessments identified the destroyed aircraft as a Kamov Ka-52 and a Mil Mi-28, along with a damaged Mi-8-family helicopter.

The attack also struck nearby fuel-storage facilities, causing a fire that Russian authorities later acknowledged. Civilian flight operations at Sochi Airport were severely disrupted, with activities restricted for more than 11 hours, leading to numerous flight delays, cancellations, and diversions, alongside temporary refueling restrictions.

zh.title: 印度延後AMCA匿蹤戰機原型機投標截止日 至10月30日
zh.summary: 印度將AMCA匿蹤戰機原型機投標截止日延至10月30日；三組民營團隊競標
body: 印度政府已將「先進中型戰鬥機」（AMCA）原型機競標案的提案截止日期，由原本的8月27日延後至10月30日，給予三組獲選入圍的民營企業團隊額外兩個月時間準備投標文件。印度國防官員表示，此次延期是應競標廠商的要求而批准，投標文件預計將於截止日的次日開啟。
獲選的「開發暨生產夥伴」將與印度航空發展署（ADA）合作，將AMCA設計概念轉化為可飛行之實體機型，建立製造基礎設施，並支援後續的飛行測試與認證工作。根據規劃，該專案預計製造五架原型機與一架結構測試件，首架原型機須在合約簽署後30個月內實現首飛，整個開發計畫預計在84個月內執行約1,800架次的測試飛行。

本次參與競標的三組民營團隊中，塔塔先進系統公司（TASL）是唯一獨立投標的企業。第二組團隊是由Larsen & Toubro領軍的聯盟，成員包括國營的Bharat Electronics Limited（BEL）與Dynamatic Technologies。第三組競標團隊則由Bharat Forge、BEML及Data Patterns共同組成。開放民營企業競標此大型戰機專案，象徵著印度過去由國營企業主導戰鬥機製造的傳統出現顯著轉變。
值得注意的是，過去長期主導印度國產戰鬥機製造、包含生產「光輝」（Tejas）戰鬥機的印度斯坦航空有限公司（HAL），並未進入最終競標名單。HAL曾參與AMCA初始評選階段，但未通過技術與財務評估。HAL事後表示，並未收到確認其被排除於競標之外的官方通知。
根據目前專案規劃，首架AMCA原型機預計於2029年左右首飛，開發階段將於下一個十年結束，量產作業則預計於2035年左右展開。這款重約25噸的雙發動機匿蹤戰鬥機，具備低可偵測性外形、內部彈艙、感測器融合與先進電子航航系統。初始量產型AMCA Mk1預計採用GE Aerospace的F414發動機。

en.title: India Extends AMCA Stealth Fighter Prototype Bid Deadline to October 30
en.summary: India extended its AMCA stealth fighter prototype bid deadline to October 30 for three private-sector teams.
body: India has extended the deadline for Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) proposals from 27 August to 30 October, giving three shortlisted private-sector teams an additional two months to prepare their submissions. According to Indian defence officials, the extension was granted following requests from the competing entities. Bids are now scheduled to open on the day following the new closing date.

The selected Development-cum-Production Partner will collaborate with the Aeronautical Development Agency (ADA) to develop the AMCA design into operational hardware, establish manufacturing facilities, and support flight-testing and certification. The development plan outlines five flying prototypes and one structural test article, with the first prototype required to fly within 30 months of signing the contract. The flight-test campaign is expected to encompass around 1,800 test sorties over an 84-month period.

Three private-sector industrial groups are competing for the major defence manufacturing contract. Tata Advanced Systems Limited (TASL) is submitting an independent bid. A second team is a consortium led by Larsen & Toubro, alongside state-owned Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) and Dynamatic Technologies. The third bidding group comprises Bharat Forge, BEML, and Data Patterns. Selecting a private entity marks a shift from earlier Indian combat aircraft manufacturing programmes.

Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), India's primary state-owned combat aircraft manufacturer that produces the Tejas fighter, is absent from the final bidder shortlist. HAL participated in the initial AMCA process but did not progress past the technical and financial evaluation stages. HAL subsequently stated it had received no official notification confirming its exclusion from the competition.

Current programme scheduling projects the first AMCA prototype to take flight around 2029, with development wrapping up in the 2030s and series production targeted to begin around 2035. The approximately 25-tonne twin-engine stealth fighter is specified to feature low-observable shaping, internal weapons bays, sensor fusion, and advanced avionics. The initial AMCA Mk1 version is set to utilize GE Aerospace F414 engines.

zh.title: 聖嬰現象預估持續至2027年 或使全球冬季航班顛簸加劇
zh.summary: 世界氣象組織預測強烈聖嬰現象將持續至2027年初，或導致冬季航班亂流增加。
body: 世界氣象組織（WMO）預測，一波非常強烈的聖嬰現象將在未來幾個月內增強，並將持續至2027年初。這項氣候現象預計將在冬季對全球航空與空中旅行產生廣泛影響。航空公司可能面臨更具不可預測性的天氣狀況，這可能導致晴空亂流增加、航班延誤，並對噴射氣流與飛行時間產生影響。

根據提供亂流與飛行員報告（PIREP）資訊的平台 SkyPath 指出，聖嬰現象會改變高空大氣的風切。風切是產生晴空亂流的主因，而這種亂流因肉眼不可見且氣象雷達無法偵測，因此特別具危險性。SkyPath 指出，研究人員分析40年的大氣資料發現，當從強烈的反聖嬰現象轉變為強烈的聖嬰現象時，北大西洋上空飛機巡航高度的風切將增加約35%。此外，SkyPath 表示，北大西洋上空的亂流總量已增加了約30%。
聖嬰現象對亂流的影響因地區而異。SkyPath 的分析顯示，美國、南美洲、東南亞、澳洲和非洲等地區預估將面臨更強的風切與更高的亂流機率。相反地，東亞地區的情況則恰好相反，聖嬰現象會減少當地的風切與亂流，而反聖嬰現象則會使之增加。

除了聖嬰現象之外，北大西洋的晴空亂流在長期上也呈現增加趨勢。一項發表於《地球物理研究通訊》（Geophysical Research Letters）的同儕審查研究，分析了1979年至2020年之間的大氣資料。這項由雷丁大學（University of Reading）與英國氣象局（Met Office）研究人員進行的研究指出，在北大西洋上空的平均觀測點，巡航高度每年發生強烈或以上等級晴空亂流的持續時間增加了55%，從1979年的17.7小時增加到2020年的27.4小時。
此外，聖嬰現象預計還將透過改變熱帶加熱效應和大氣環流，進而改變全球噴射氣流的位置與強度。在聖嬰現象期間，噴射氣流最強的部分通常會向南移動，並向東延伸跨越北太平洋，使其更接近北美洲，這將進一步影響航班的飛行路徑與飛行時間。

en.title: El Nino Forecast to Intensify Into 2027, Bringing Increased Winter Flight Turbulence
en.summary: The World Meteorological Organisation warns El Nino could increase winter flight turbulence and delays through early 2027.
body: The World Meteorological Organisation (WMO) has forecast that a very strong El Niño climate pattern will intensify in the coming months and persist into early 2027. This development is expected to have widespread effects on global aviation and air travel during the winter season. Airlines could face more unpredictable weather conditions, which may lead to increased clear-air turbulence, flight delays, and alterations to jet streams and flight times.

According to turbulence and PIREP platform SkyPath, El Niño changes wind shear in the upper atmosphere, which is the primary driver of clear-air turbulence. This type of turbulence is particularly hazardous as it is invisible and cannot be detected by weather radar. SkyPath noted that atmospheric data spanning 40 years shows wind shear at aircraft cruising levels over the North Atlantic Ocean increases by approximately 35% when transitioning from a very strong La Niña to a very strong El Niño. Furthermore, SkyPath reported that turbulence over the North Atlantic has already increased by about 30%.

The impact of El Niño on flight conditions varies by region. SkyPath's analysis indicates that stronger wind shear and elevated turbulence probabilities are anticipated over the United States, South America, Southeast Asia, Australia, and Africa. However, the phenomenon has the opposite effect in East Asia, where El Niño is associated with a decrease in wind shear and turbulence, while La Niña increases them.

This climate pattern occurs alongside a longer-term trend of rising clear-air turbulence. A peer-reviewed study published in Geophysical Research Letters analyzed atmospheric data from 1979 to 2020. Conducted by researchers from the University of Reading and the Met Office, the study found that at an average point over the North Atlantic, the annual duration of severe-or-greater clear-air turbulence at cruising altitudes increased by 55%, rising from 17.7 hours in 1979 to 27.4 hours in 2020.

Additionally, El Niño is expected to alter the position and strength of global jet streams by changing tropical heating and atmospheric circulation. During such events, the strongest portions of the jet stream typically shift south and extend farther east across the North Pacific Ocean, bringing the jet stream closer to North America, which can impact flight paths and durations.

zh.title: 英國Global Airlines面臨清算聲請 旗下A380復飛進度受阻
zh.summary: 英國Global Airlines遭債權人提清算聲請；旗下A380停飛法國
body: 英國新創航空公司Global Airlines面臨新的清算聲請。官方紀錄顯示，債權人Jessica Huffman Reese於2026年5月29日提出聲請，並由律師事務所Vedder Price代表。法院排定7月15日與9月2日舉行聽證會，索賠金額與聽證結果未公開。
該公司2025年亦曾面臨清算聲請後獲撤回。清算聲請為債權人尋求公司解散的程序，不代表已破產。目前Global Airlines旗下唯一的空中巴士A380客機（9H-GLOBL）仍停飛於法國塔布。
執行長James Asquith於6月表示，目標於2026年底前恢復A380飛航並研議新航線。該公司曾於2025年5月透過Hi Fly Malta濕租合作，以A380執飛格拉斯哥至紐約（JFK）包機。

en.title: Global Airlines Faces Winding-Up Petition as Airbus A380 Return Plans Stall
en.summary: Global Airlines faces a new winding-up petition while attempting to restore its Airbus A380 to service.
body: UK start-up Global Airlines is facing a new winding-up petition filed by creditor Jessica Huffman Reese on May 29, 2026. Official records show the creditor is represented by US law firm Vedder Price, with hearings listed for July 15 and September 2, 2026. The claimed amount and hearing outcomes remain undisclosed.

The carrier faced a similar petition in 2025 that was later withdrawn. A winding-up petition is a legal procedure seeking company liquidation, but does not prove insolvency. Meanwhile, Global Airlines' sole Airbus A380 (9H-GLOBL) has been grounded in Tarbes, France, since last summer.

Chief executive James Asquith outlined goals in June to return the A380 to service before late 2026 and evaluate routes including the Maldives. The carrier operated limited charter flights between Glasgow and New York (JFK) in May 2025 via a wet-lease arrangement with Hi Fly Malta.

zh.title: 印尼喀拉喀托之子火山噴發致雅加達等七座機場關閉
zh.summary: 喀拉喀托之子火山噴發；印尼七座機場關閉；逾27萬旅客受阻
body: 印尼七座機場（包含雅加達的兩大門戶：蘇加諾-哈達國際機場 (CGK) 與哈利姆·珀達納庫蘇馬機場 (HLP)）於2026年9月7日週一維持關閉。此次關閉是由於喀拉喀托之子火山噴發，其產生的火山灰飄入商業航班使用的空域，導致飛行安全受到威脅。
印尼交通部表示，自2026年9月5日以來，這波火山活動已導致約2,300架次航班及270,337名旅客受到航班取消、延誤或轉降的影響。其他維持關閉的機場還包括：Radin Inten II、Budiarto、Pondok Cabe、Muhammad Taufiq Kiemas 以及 Husein Sastranegara 機場；而 Atung Bungsu 機場則已於週一上午重新開放。

en.title: Volcanic Ash from Anak Krakatau Forces Closure of Seven Indonesian Airports
en.summary: Anak Krakatau volcanic ash forces Indonesian airport closures, disrupting over 270,000 passengers.
body: Seven Indonesian airports, including Jakarta's main gateways Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK) and Halim Perdanakusuma Airport (HLP), remained closed on Monday, September 7, 2026. The closures followed eruptions from the Anak Krakatau volcano, which sent volcanic ash into airspace used by commercial aircraft, making flying unsafe.

Indonesia's Transport Ministry reported that the ongoing volcanic activity has affected around 2,300 flights and 270,337 passengers through cancellations, delays, and diversions since September 5, 2026. Other affected facilities remaining closed include Radin Inten II, Budiarto, Pondok Cabe, Muhammad Taufiq Kiemas, and Husein Sastranegara airports, while Atung Bungsu Airport reopened on Monday morning.

zh.title: 希臘空軍F-4戰機於航空展失事墜毀 兩名飛行員殉職調查中
zh.summary: 希臘空軍一架F-4戰機於塔納格拉基地航空展墜毀；兩名飛官殉職；事故原因調查中
body: 希臘空軍一架雙座型F-4幽靈II（F-4 Phantom II）戰鬥機於2026年9月5日在雅典附近的塔納格拉空軍基地（Tanagra Air Base，代碼LGTG）舉辦的航空展中失事墜毀。根據希臘官方說明，這架戰機當時正在執行低空單機飛行表演展示，於特技機動過程中失控墜毀，造成機上兩名飛行員不幸殉職。官方同時證實，事故發生地點距離機場約兩公里，並未造成地面觀展民眾或旁觀者受傷。

根據航空安全網（Aviation Safety Network）紀錄，這架涉事戰機為麥道F-4E AUP幽靈II型（McDonnell Douglas F-4E AUP Phantom II），隸屬於希臘空軍第117作戰聯隊第338戰術飛行隊。資料顯示，該機在進場接近28C跑道時高度過低，隨後撞擊樹木與一棟工業建築並起火燃燒，墜毀地點距離跑道頭約3公里。希臘相關單位表示，目前事故具體原因與詳細經過仍處於調查階段，官方尚未發布最終調查結論。

希臘自1974年起分批引進約120架F-4幽靈戰機，來源包括新造機以及來自美國空軍國民警衛隊與德國空軍的二手機型。多年來希臘空軍已有約33架F-4戰機因各式事故損失。現役留存的戰機均已透過航電提升計畫（Avionics Upgrade Programme, AUP）完成升級，目前僅有升級後的F-4E AUP機型繼續在希臘空軍服役，並由位於安德拉維達（Andravida）的第117作戰聯隊第338「阿瑞斯」戰術轟炸機隊負責操作。

希臘政府於2024年公布空軍現代化計畫，預計逐步退役包含F-4幽靈II、早期型F-16 Block 30以及幻象2000-5（Mirage 2000-5）等舊型戰機，同時規劃引進達梭疾風（Dassault Rafale）、F-35A匿蹤戰機並升級現役F-16 Block 50戰機。希臘空軍現役F-4戰機的退役時程與新型F-35A戰機交機進度掛鉤，預計將持續服役至2020年代後期，目前官方尚未確定最終退役日期。希臘也是目前全球僅存三個仍在使用F-4戰機的國家之一。

en.title: Greek Air Force F-4 Phantom Fighter Crashes at Airshow, Killing Two Pilots
en.summary: Greek Air Force F-4 Phantom crashes during airshow near Athens; two pilots killed; cause under investigation
body: A Hellenic Air Force two-seat F-4E Phantom II fighter jet crashed on September 5, 2026, during an aerial display at an airshow held at Tanagra Air Base (LGTG) near Athens, killing both pilots on board. According to Greek officials, the aircraft was performing a low-level solo demonstration at the time of the accident and crashed while maneuvering. Authorities confirmed that the crash site was located approximately two kilometers from the airfield and that no bystanders or spectators on the ground were injured.

Data from the Aviation Safety Network indicated that the involved aircraft was a McDonnell Douglas F-4E AUP Phantom II operated by the 338th Squadron of the 117th Combat Wing. According to the tracking reports, the fighter came in too low while approaching runway 28C, striking trees and an industrial building before bursting into flames approximately three kilometers from the runway threshold. Greek officials emphasized that the official cause and specific circumstances of the crash remain under active investigation, with no formal findings determined yet.

Greece originally acquired approximately 120 F-4 Phantoms across multiple batches starting in 1974, comprising both new-build aircraft and second-hand jets from the US Air National Guard and the German Luftwaffe. Over decades of operation, around 33 Greek Phantoms have been lost to accidents. The surviving operational aircraft were upgraded under the Avionics Upgrade Programme (AUP), with only modernized F-4E AUP variants remaining in active military service with the 338th Squadron "Ares" based at Andravida.

In 2024, Greece announced comprehensive air force modernization plans that include phased retirements of its ageing F-4 Phantoms, older F-16 Block 30s, and Mirage 2000-5 fighters, while introducing new Dassault Rafales and F-35s alongside upgrades to Block 50 F-16s. The retirement schedule for the remaining F-4 fleet is linked directly to the arrival of replacement F-35A fighters, suggesting the aircraft could remain operational into the late 2020s, although no finalized retirement date has been officially confirmed. Greece remains one of only three nations worldwide still operating the Cold War-era F-4 Phantom.
